preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The integer n for each test case is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The integer k for each test case is between 0 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of n over all test cases <= 2 * 10^6
preconditions.description: The sum of all n values across all test cases is at most 2 * 10^6.

postconditions.expression: Output is either a permutation of 1, 2, ..., n or -1
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must be a permutation of numbers 1 to n where the number of indices i for which A_i = i is exactly k, or -1 if no such permutation exists.
